snippet.title: Wasteland Bites - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wasteland Bites on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748640/Wasteland_Bites/

Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.
